_about: Assessed Apple build diagnostics that do not block the CLI repository's scripts/release.py. Detailed assessments: docs/PERFORMANCE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md#compiler-diagnostics-2026-10-07. Unlisted warnings block publication.

warnings.origin: Typed attributed-string font assignments in ChatMarkdown
warnings.reason: Existing typed attributed-string API; font values are immutable
warnings.risk: Relies on fonts never being mutated after assignment
warnings.follow_up: Revisit when the SDK marks the attribute scopes Sendable

warnings.origin: Paragraph-style assignments in ChatMarkdown (macOS and the shared iOS branches)
warnings.reason: Each style is built locally and never mutated after assignment; no concurrent writer
warnings.risk: Relies on styles staying local and immutable
warnings.follow_up: Revisit with the SDK's Sendable annotations

warnings.match: ^PairingScannerView\.swift: (capture of 'session' with non-Sendable type 'AVCaptureSession'|add '@preconcurrency' to treat 'Sendable'-related errors from module 'AVFoundation')
warnings.origin: CaptureSessionRunner start/stop on its private serial queue
warnings.reason: All configuration/start/stop run on the same serial queue after viewDidLoad configuration
warnings.risk: Ownership relies on that lifecycle order
warnings.follow_up: Move the session into an actor-isolated owner when touching the scanner

warnings.match: ^appintentsmetadataprocessor: Metadata extraction skipped, no AppIntents.framework dependency found
warnings.reason: Corral declares no App Intents and does not link the framework
warnings.risk: None; no Siri/Shortcuts metadata is produced
warnings.follow_up: None until App Intents are adopted

warnings.match: ^xcodebuild: Using the first of multiple matching destinations
warnings.origin: Selecting the host macOS destination with both architectures
warnings.reason: Release deliberately builds arm64 and x86_64; the first host selection does not narrow the binary
warnings.risk: None; the universal binary is read back
warnings.follow_up: Use an explicit host destination when changing the build recipe
